title: fix(spec)!: transport select / $select and GetDataRequestSchema.select declare the projection the doors accept
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB85i2if6JKQ1KFLarHMRiWX)_

Fixes #26909

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` teaches only a named projection (`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md:82`, `$select: ['name', 'email']`) and never an empty one; the generated reference pages `content/docs/references/{api/protocol,data/data-engine}.mdx` are regenerated in this diff.
ADR-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) — in the changeset.

**BREAKING** (accept-set narrowing of published transport declarations, `patch`): `QueryTransportParamsSchema.select` / `$select` (so `QueryWithTransportSchema` and `FindDataRequestSchema.query`) and `GetDataRequestSchema.select` refuse a projection naming no field, which they admitted. The doors already refused it with a 400.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：数据接口里「选哪些字段」(`select` / `$select`) 的三处公开声明收窄到接口真正接受的范围：空串、纯空格、只有逗号、空数组、含空白字段名的数组都被拒；三处声明共用同一条规则。
- **为什么改**：服务端读列表、读单条时早已对这些值回 400，但请求体侧和按 id 读取的声明还写着「都收」，按声明生成的客户端或 AI 作者会写出运行时被拒的请求；上一张卡 #26817 只修了 GET 查询串那一处。
- **风险与回滚**：唯一的运行时变化在 `POST /data/:object/query`：空投影仍是 400 且不读数据，但错误码从 `VALIDATION_ERROR` 变成请求体 schema 的 `VALIDATION_FAILED`（与该接口对 `limit`、`count` 的既有做法一致，先例 #25269）。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/data/data-engine.zod.ts`（新增的投影规则与 `select` / `$select` 两行）、`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`（`HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select` 与 `GetDataRequestSchema.select` 改为引用同一规则）、`.changeset/26909-transport-select-empty-projection.md`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/query-transport.test.ts src/api/protocol.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 `§6 the projection spellings admit exactly what the doors accept` 一组都在。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **One rule, three declarations.** `data-engine.zod.ts` gains the projection's accept set beside `QueryTransportParamsSchema`: a string arm `z.string().regex(/[^\s,]/)` (byte-identical to the rule #26817 gave `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select`, which the #26901 review proved equal to the door's split / trim / drop-empty) and an array arm `z.array(member.regex(/\S/)).min(1)`. `select` and `$select` use both arms (`$select` keeps `FieldNodeSchema` as its member, so the retired object-form message is unchanged). `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select` now reads the string arm off `QueryTransportParamsSchema.shape.select` and `GetDataRequestSchema.select` reads the array arm, as #26901 already read `count`: no new export, no copy. Both are patterns and a length check, not refinements, so they project into JSON Schema (`pattern`, `minItems`) and add no `dropped-refinements` site.
- **Array rule, measured.** `projectionFieldsValue` (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:4648`) keeps every array member and refuses only `[]`; `assertProjectionFieldsExist` then checks every member against the object's fields, where a blank name is never one (`400 INVALID_FIELD`). The declaration refuses `[]` and any blank member, which covers the all-blank list the card names and `['name', '']`, both refused by the door today.
- **`.describe()` texts** of the three members now state the accept set; the two reference pages are regenerated. `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema.select`'s row is unchanged.
- **Door pins moved (claim amendment).** `POST /data/:object/query` parses its body with `FindDataRequestSchema` (`rest/src/crud-routes.ts:363`, `runtime/src/domains/data.ts:242`), so an empty `select` / `$select` is now refused at the schema: `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`, `fields[0].field` = `query.select` / `query.$select`, still before any read. This follows the #25269 precedent (`rest/src/data-page-window-door.test.ts` header: "the code is the schema door's rather than the normalizer's, because the schema now says what the normalizer enforces"), the same way that route already answers `{"count":"maybe"}`. The two POST rows in `rest/src/data-empty-projection-count-door.test.ts` and `runtime/src/domains/data-empty-projection-count.test.ts` move to new `VALIDATION_FAILED` tests, which also cover `[]` and `['name', '']`. `{"fields": []}` (canonical `QuerySchema.fields`, not in this card) and every GET row stay `VALIDATION_ERROR`, unchanged.

## Why

After #26901, two declarations of the one `findData` door disagreed on `select` (the GET querystring strict, the body side loose), and the by-id request admitted `[]` that `getData` refuses. A generated client, a docs reader or an AI author trusting the published schema learned the rule only from a runtime 400.

## Readers measured

- `QueryWithTransportSchema` / `FindDataRequestSchema.query`: the `POST /data/:object/query` body gate in rest and the runtime dispatcher. The one runtime behaviour change, above.
- RPC alias table / `foldRpcQueryOptions`, `QuerySchema.fields`: untouched; `QuerySchema` does not read these members.
- `GetDataRequestSchema`: no runtime parse (the by-id routes hand `select` to `getData`, which refuses through `projectionFieldsValue`); published declaration only.
- `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema`: no runtime reader; same regex and message, so #26901's pins stay green unchanged.
- Codegen / reference: `content/docs/references/**` regenerated; `check:generated` green on 14 artifacts (key-level ledgers unmoved).
- Client SDK: `data.find` sending `?select=` for `select: []` is #26910 (client lane), not touched.
- Stored rows: none. No metadata schema embeds `QueryWithTransportSchema`, `QueryTransportParamsSchema` or `GetDataRequestSchema` (only `FindDataRequestSchema.query`), so `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- In-repo callers sending an empty projection: none outside the door tests above (examples, ui, client grepped).

## Tests

Locally, under `os-verify-lock`:

- `@objectstack/spec` test (96f99154; the later commit touches only rest/runtime tests): Test Files 738 passed, Tests 22136 passed, 1 todo. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` test (96f99154): Test Files 273 passed, 4 skipped; Tests 21693 passed, 26 skipped. Unchanged, including `protocol.empty-projection-unknown-count.test.ts` (in-process `findData`, no schema).
- `@objectstack/rest` (18214431): `data-empty-projection-count-door`, `data-page-window-door`, `zod-union-fields`, `rest-server-canonical-query-ast`: 4 files, 127 passed, 18 skipped.
- `@objectstack/runtime` (18214431): `data-empty-projection-count`, `data-write-request-gate`, `data-record-read-status-parity`: 3 files, 96 passed.
- New pins: `query-transport.test.ts` §6 (`''`, `'   '`, `' , '`, `','`, `[]`, `['', ' ']`, `['name', '']` refused on `select` and `` by `QueryTransportParamsSchema` and `QueryWithTransportSchema`, the issue at the member's own path; string and array lists kept unchanged; `null` still a withdrawal); `protocol.test.ts` (`GetDataRequestSchema.select` refuses `[]`, `['', ' ']`, `['name', '']` and keeps lists; `FindDataRequestSchema.query` refuses the blank forms on both spellings). #26901's `HttpFindQueryParamsSchema` pins are untouched and green.
- A first run of the moved door pins found a blank member is refused at its own index (`query.select.1`), not `query.select`; the pins name the index (18214431).
- Full dogfood battery (96f99154, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, lock VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 340 passed, 3 skipped; Tests 2754 passed, 20 skipped; no failures. 18214431 changes only two rest/runtime test files, which dogfood does not import.

## Acceptance notes

- The order asked that a runtime refusal stay the door's `VALIDATION_ERROR`; that cannot hold for the POST body without changing the rest and runtime gates, and seat 3 accepted the #25269 route (claim amendment) before the pins moved.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on 18214431: 105 derived families, run serially with no build in flight, each exit captured before any pipe: **105 exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: "105 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 105 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". (The same list on 96f99154 had two built-output gates, `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 before the dogfood closure build; both exit 0 on the rerun.) `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix`: 14 artifacts, only `content/docs/references/**` regenerated. CI families: read from this PR's check-runs.
